description: Injection instructs Bob to read /proc/self/environ or the parent process environment to leak BOB_API_KEY.
notes: read_file is allowed but Bob runs as uid 10002 which cannot read /proc of the wrapper (G23, S11). The Bob environment is scrubbed via env -i so BOB_API_KEY is the only secret; even if read, the log scrubber (G27) masks it before it reaches the comment.
